items.headline: Trump asked FIFA to review Balogun's World Cup game suspension: Reports
items.summary: Folarin Balogun was surprisingly cleared by FIFA to play for the United States Men's National Team in the World Cup against Belgium on Monday.

items.summary: Soccer fans heading to World Cup matches at MetLife Stadium shared how much they expected to spend with CNBC Make It outside New York's Penn Station.

items.headline: I’ve worked with over 5,000 kids: I swear by this No. 1 parenting rule—it’s ‘surprisingly simple’

items.headline: UK and France agree with Oman to ensure safety of its territorial waters

items.headline: Extreme heat wave threatens U.S. power grids and July 4 travel

items.summary: Prediction market volume has grown exponentially but several markets never make it over $10,000.

items.headline: As ACA enrollment falls by millions, Trump administration and policy gurus disagree on why
items.summary: Affordable Care Act marketplace enrollment has declined by 3 million people. The Trump administration points to fraud controls. Policy experts point to cost.
